treatment_summary: The patient’s stage 2 hypertension remains uncontrolled on lisinopril 10 mg. Per NICE NG136, add amlodipine 5 mg daily as a second‑line agent and review BP in 4 weeks, titrating to 10 mg if needed. Continue lisinopril, contraception, and acetaminophen. Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and BP regularly; obtain missing labs (eGFR, potassium, lipids, LFTs) and calculate QRISK to assess need for statin therapy. Provide lifestyle counseling (salt <6 g/day, DASH diet, 150 min/week exercise, weight management, smoking cessation).
